title: ÉTS's video game creation club
intro: Conjure is a student club at École de technologie supérieure dedicated to video game creation. Since 2009, it has brought together programmers, artists, and designers around real projects, training, and a fully equipped room.
history: Founded in 2009, Conjure grew out of ÉTS students wanting to practice video game development outside the classroom. Over the years the club became a recognized name on the Montreal student scene, present at the Ubisoft Game Lab, the Montreal Game Jam, and its own annual gala.

membership.title: Become a member
membership.description: Conjure is open to every ÉTS student, regardless of program or experience level. No prior game development experience is required — just the drive to learn and create as a team.
benefits: Access to the room and its equipment (VR, workstations, game engines)
Training and workshops led by members and industry professionals
Competition entries (Ubisoft Game Lab, game jams) as part of a team
Showcasing your projects at the annual Gala Conjure

ctaText: Join the Discord to meet the team and hear about upcoming activities.
